sections.heading: What is NotebookLM?
sections.body: Google's AI research assistant that only reads YOUR documents. No hallucinations, no internet noise — just source-grounded answers with inline citations.
bulletPoints: Built on Gemini 2.5 Pro with 2M token context window
Accepts PDFs, Docs, Slides, YouTube, websites, audio
Free tier: 100 notebooks, 50 sources of 500K words each
Your data is never used to train AI models

sections.heading: The RAG Engine
sections.body: NotebookLM uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation to ground every answer in your actual sources.

sections.heading: Audio Overviews
sections.body: The feature that broke the internet. Two AI hosts generate a podcast-style deep dive from your documents — complete with banter, interruptions, and genuine insight.
bulletPoints: Went viral September 2024 — sounds eerily human
Spotify Wrapped 2024 used it for personalized recaps
Interactive mode: join the conversation and ask questions
Customizable tone, length, even humor level

quote.text: The future of AI assistance isn't about one tool replacing another — it's about specialized tools that excel at specific tasks.
quote.author: Dr. Sarah Hooker
quote.role: AI Researcher, Former Google Brain Team

sections.heading: Under the Hood
sections.body: NotebookLM is RAG at scale. Here's the Gemini API equivalent of what it does.

codeSnippet.code:
import google.generativeai as genai

genai.configure(api_key="YOUR_KEY")
model = genai.GenerativeModel("gemini-2.0-flash")

# Upload sources — just like NotebookLM
doc = genai.upload_file("research.pdf")

# Ask questions grounded in YOUR data
response = model.generate_content(
  ["Summarize the key findings", doc]
)
print(response.text)  # With citations

sections.heading: The Takeaway
sections.body: NotebookLM isn't trying to be ChatGPT. It's the anti-hallucination tool — a personal AI that knows exactly what you know, and nothing else. And it's free.
bulletPoints: Perfect for researchers, students, and knowledge workers
Audio & Video Overviews transform passive docs into active learning
Gemini integration turns notebooks into reasoning engines
